kernel.name: warptiling_sgemm
kernel.description: CUDA SGEMM kernel using three-level tiling: block-level (BM x BN tiles cached in shared memory), warp-level (WM x WN sub-tiles assigned to warps), and thread-level (TM x TN results computed per thread). Derived from static_assert constraints in a real CUDA GEMM implementation.

register_model.formula: WMITER * WNITER * TM * TN + TM + TN + 15
register_model.description: Estimated registers per thread: threadResults[WMITER*WNITER*TM*TN] for accumulated partial products, regM[TM] for caching A tile entries, regN[TN] for caching B tile entries, plus 15 registers for loop indices (bkIdx, wmIdx, wnIdx, dotIdx, resIdxM, resIdxN), thread position (threadRow, threadCol), block position (cRow, cCol), pointer arithmetic, and GMEM loading indices.

smem_model.description: Shared memory data bytes: As[BM*BK] stores block tile of A (transposed for vectorized access), Bs[BK*BN] stores block tile of B. Each element is float32 (4 bytes).

WMITER.description: Number of warp M-dimension iterations; must be a positive integer (guaranteed by constraint 4)

constraints.reason: Warp tile must evenly divide block tile in the N dimension
Warp tile must evenly divide block tile in the M dimension
Total number of warp tiles must equal the number of warps in the block
Thread tiles times iterations must evenly cover the warp tile
M-dimension iterations must evenly divide warp M tile
N-dimension iterations must evenly divide warp N tile
Avoid quantization during vectorized GMEM-to-SMEM tiling of B rows (each thread loads float4 = 4 elements)
Avoid quantization during vectorized GMEM-to-SMEM tiling of A rows
Avoid quantization effects in the N dimension of thread tile layout
Avoid quantization effects in the M dimension of thread tile layout
Enable vectorized float4 loads of A tile from global memory
Enable vectorized float4 loads of B tile from global memory

occupancy_model.description: Theoretical SM occupancy calculation following CUDA's hardware resource allocation model.
occupancy_model.bottleneck_rule: The bottleneck resource(s) are those whose max_blocks_by_X value equals the final max_blocks_per_sm. When multiple resources tie, list all of them.

arithmetic_intensity_model.formula: (2.0 * BM * BN * BK) / ((BM * BK + BK * BN) * 4)
arithmetic_intensity_model.description: FLOPs (multiply + add per element in the K-dimension dot product) divided by bytes transferred from GMEM to SMEM per block tile iteration.

fields.total_valid_configs: integer: number of parameter combinations satisfying ALL constraints (kernel constraints + hardware constraints)
fields.max_occupancy_pct: float: highest occupancy percentage across all valid configs
fields.num_configs_at_max_occupancy: integer: count of valid configs achieving exactly max_occupancy_pct
fields.num_configs_above_50pct_occupancy: integer: count of valid configs with occupancy_pct strictly > 50.0

bottleneck_distribution.registers_only: integer: configs where only registers limit the block count
bottleneck_distribution.smem_only: integer: configs where only shared memory limits the block count
bottleneck_distribution.warps_only: integer: configs where only warps limit the block count
bottleneck_distribution.multiple: integer: configs where two or more resources tie as the limit

fields.occupancy_histogram: object mapping occupancy_pct values (as strings) to counts, e.g. {"0.0": 92, "25.0": 164, ...}

specific_configs.label: string matching the query label
specific_configs.valid: boolean: whether all constraints are satisfied
specific_configs.smem_bytes: integer: raw shared memory data bytes before overhead/rounding, or null if invalid
specific_configs.bottleneck: list of strings from {'registers', 'smem', 'warps'} sorted alphabetically, or null if invalid
